description: In every PA-model, the next history is the preceding history with the new step output appended.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history_successor_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  {n : ℕ} (h : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program (n + 2)) (x : Fin n → M) (k : M) :
  (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history h).value
      (Fin.snoc x (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M k)) =
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listAppend.value
      ![(Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history h).value (Fin.snoc x k),
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listCons.value
          ![h.value
              (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc x k)
                ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history h).value (Fin.snoc x k))),
            Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M]]
